summary: The API version the SDK pins and sends by default changes from 2026-06-24.dahlia to 2026-07-29.dahlia

Fields typed as non-exhaustive ("open") enums now include a shared OtherString type (string & Record<never, never>) in their unions, so they are no longer closed literal unions (exhaustive switches and assignments to literal-union types stop type-checking)
Limited-use request parameters removed: proof_of_registration on AccountCreateParams.documents and dynamic_tax_rates on Checkout.SessionCreateParams.line_items[]
The API version the SDK pins and sends by default changes from 2026-07-29.dahlia to 2026-08-26.dahlia
Serializing a V2 request parameter that is a discriminated union now throws when its discriminator is missing or not a string, instead of sending it without int64/decimal coercion
cryptogram is removed from payment_method_details.card.three_d_secure on PaymentAttemptRecord and PaymentRecord
Webhook verification helpers (webhooks.constructEvent and the signature verifiers) throw when given an empty webhook secret instead of computing a signature with it
The pinned default API version moves to the new major API release 2026-09-30.endive (from 2026-08-26.dahlia), bringing that release's breaking API changes
Node.js 18 support is dropped; Node.js 20 is the minimum supported version
Stripe.V2List<T> no longer declares the V1-only object, has_more and url fields (never populated); V2 lists paginate with next_page_url / previous_page_url
V2 request address properties are typed with operation-specific V2 interfaces instead of the shared V1 Stripe.AddressParam / Stripe.JapanAddressParam types
The Stripe.ErrorType type namespace is removed; use Stripe.errors (e.g. Stripe.errors.StripeCardError) in type annotations
A response whose body stalls or is cut off before completion now throws StripeConnectionError instead of StripeAPIError
webhooks.signature.verifyHeader() and verifyHeaderAsync() check the timestamp against Webhook.DEFAULT_TOLERANCE when tolerance is omitted, instead of skipping the timestamp check; pass 0 to skip
webhooks.constructEvent() with tolerance 0 now skips timestamp verification instead of applying the default tolerance
AccountRejectParams.reason (accounts.reject) is typed as an enum of allowed values instead of string

New values (marked breaking) on existing response enums: requirements errors[].code (invalid_address_cmra_address, invalid_address_registered_agent_address), Reserve.Plan.status/type (other, manual_release), Reserve.Release.reason (hold_expired), V2 account capability status (rejected) and status_details[].code (rejected_*)
The value bulk_hold_expiry is removed from the Reserve.Release.reason enum
Charge.payment_method_details.card.mandate changes from string to expandable(Mandate) (string | Stripe.Mandate)

The payment_method_types request parameter is removed from Checkout.SessionCreateParams, PaymentIntentCreateParams/UpdateParams/ConfirmParams and SetupIntentCreateParams/UpdateParams (use allowed_payment_method_types)

Checkout.Session.payment_method_options.bancontact.setup_future_usage and PaymentIntent.payment_method_options.blik.setup_future_usage change from the literal 'none' to the enum 'none' | 'off_session'
countries is removed from FinancialConnections.Session.filters and FinancialConnections.SessionCreateParams.filters (use country)

The billing_cycle_anchor parameter of SubscriptionUpdateParams, SubscriptionResumeParams and InvoiceCreatePreviewParams.subscription_details changes from 'now' | 'unchanged' (| timestamp) to the new billing_cycle_anchor_param type
payto is removed from PaymentMethodUpdateParams
Radar.PaymentEvaluation.signals.fraudulent_payment.score changes from number to number | null
configurations is removed from use_case.account_onboarding and use_case.account_update on V2.Core.AccountLink and V2.Core.AccountLinkCreateParams
